import cv2
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pathlib import Path

stylegan_fake = list(Path(r'data\raw\cross_eval\stylegan\Final Dataset\Fake').glob('*.jpg'))[:5]
stylegan_real = list(Path(r'data\raw\cross_eval\stylegan\Final Dataset\Real').glob('*.jpg'))[:5]

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 5, figsize=(15, 6))
for i, img_path in enumerate(stylegan_real):
    img = cv2.cvtColor(cv2.imread(str(img_path)), cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
    axes[0, i].imshow(img)
    axes[0, i].set_title('Real', color='green')
    axes[0, i].axis('off')

for i, img_path in enumerate(stylegan_fake):
    img = cv2.cvtColor(cv2.imread(str(img_path)), cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
    axes[1, i].imshow(img)
    axes[1, i].set_title('Fake', color='red')
    axes[1, i].axis('off')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('../experiments/stylegan_samples.png', dpi=150)
plt.show()
